news_analysis.headline_hook: ₹42.35 Lakh Crore Evaporated! Per Minute-ku ₹8 Crore Loss - Unga Wallet la irundhu Indirect ah Evlo Siphon Aagudhu Theriyuma?
news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: A report published on September 27, 2026, highlights a staggering ₹42.35 lakh crore in global fraud losses, framing it as a systemic threat to the global financial ecosystem.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Retail investors fear that this massive figure represents a direct, immediate 'market crash' event or a singular localized hack that will wipe out their specific brokerage accounts overnight.
news_analysis.institutional_reality: Institutions view this figure as a 'cost of doing business' metric—a cumulative, multi-year, global aggregate of cyber-theft, phishing, and financial crime that is already priced into the risk-adjusted returns of major financial institutions and insurance premiums.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Never conflate global aggregate fraud statistics with localized systemic risk; focus on individual account security (2FA/Hardware keys) rather than macro-fear.

carousel_outline.focus: The 42.35 Lakh Crore headline is a distraction—here is why.

slides.title: How Capital Quietly Leaks
slides.card_text: Retail investors crash-ஆல பணத்தை இழப்பதை விட, unverified links மற்றும் Phishing scams மூலமா மெதுவா micro-transfers வழியாகத்தான் பணத்தை இழக்கிறார்கள்.

slides.title: The Institutional Pricing Mechanism
slides.card_text: Big funds இந்த fraud risk-ஐ 'Cost of Business'-ஆ treat பண்ணி, insurance premiums மூலமா risk-adjusted returns-ல ஏற்கனவே price-in பண்ணிடுவாங்க.

slides.title: Golden Rule for Retail Safety
slides.card_text: Macro aggregate statistics பார்த்து panic ஆகாதீங்க! Focus 100% on individual account security like 2FA and Hardware Keys.
